notes.title: New version 1.03!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We have just uploaded version 1.03 for Mac and Windows!

What have we done? A fair bit!

- Added the ability to skip the introduction (the intro was initially a method for preloading everything but now we've done some voodoo and you are now able to skip the intro)

- Squashed some bugs

- Added a new feature that will show you all the times you died in a level (as you have been playing that level, if you exit the level and re-enter the level the previous die points are deleted)

Let me know what you think of that feature, I'm thinking about expanding it into a scoring system....

Anyways, what else is coming? SpaceRoads Classic Pack!

There are going to be more levels coming soon that are more Skyroads than ever! Don't fret though, as always the updated levels will be totally free!
